_meta.view: top-down forest auto-tile terrain (grass / dirt / path edges)

_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED 2026-08-06 (drawn over the PNG at 6x — lines land exactly on tile edges; 240x144 / 16 = 15x9 = 135 frames, no remainder). Forest auto-tile terrain for a simple, standard green top-down environment. Layout is 3x3 terrain blocks with a companion 2x2 patch block beside each: complete terrains are leafy-dirt, leafy-limestone, leafy-brownstone, leafy-grass-water and dirt-water, all following the sheet convention 'surround-fill' (leafy-dirt = a brown dirt fill inside a leafy-grass surround; it was called 'leafy-grass' until 2026-08-06, which named the surround and collided with the plain green-grass fill variants leafy-grass-1/2 at frames 78/79); the 2x2 blocks are OBJECTS (a closed patch of one terrain inside another) and are registered as named regions in tileLabels.json, not as terrains. Right-hand columns 10-14 are plain water/deep-water fill variants. Whole grid browsable by frame index. HOW THE SIZE WAS ORIGINALLY CHOSEN: source PNG is 240x144 and the 16px grid was inferred from the pack's other 16px sheets (ts_forest 192x496 etc., which only tile cleanly at 16); that inference has since been confirmed visually, as recorded above.
